title: The Effect of Pre-chlorination on the Treatment of Excess Sludge Using Microbial Fuel Cells: Microbial Communities on the Anode Biofilm
description: Excess sludge was treated using a microbial fuel cell. The sludge was categorized into chlorinated, unchlorinated, and initial sludge, with each 3-day period constituting one stage. New sludge was introduced, and the sludge from the fourth, fifth, sixth, and seventh stages was mixed together and submitted for 16S analysis.
